args.summary: checkout-api deployment v2.3.1 failed health checks in production across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an observed error rate of 18%. Mitigation: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent previously healthy production release, in all production regions. Rollback has been verified (all three regions now serving v2.3.0). Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before attempting re-release; monitoring service health to confirm recovery.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production with an 18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while **v2.3.0** was the most recent previously healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all three production regions. Rollback is verified and the service is now **healthy with a 0.2% error rate**.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** — "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0" — describing the failure, the mitigation, and follow-up needs. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommended follow-up: investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before attempting a re-release.
